# LOCIVA — Location Intelligence & Civic Analytics

> LOCIVA is a web platform that combines interactive maps, spatial data, business analysis, and community reports to help users evaluate business locations and understand area conditions before making decisions.

## About
- [Homepage](https://lociva.vercel.app/): Overview of LOCIVA's location intelligence platform, features, and how it works.
- [Interactive Map](https://lociva.vercel.app/view-maps): Explore the interactive map with POI layers, business analysis, and community reports.

## Key Features
- Location potential scoring based on population, pedestrian activity, accessibility, target market, competition, and area compatibility.
- Interactive business simulator: drag-and-drop business types on the map to evaluate locations.
- What-if simulation: compare multiple locations side by side.
- Civic reports: community-submitted infrastructure issues that feed into area-condition signals.
- Vendor routes: plan multi-stop selling routes on real OSM road networks via OSRM.
- Saved candidates: save and compare candidate locations.
- BPS demographic data integration for supported administrative regions.
- AI-assisted business differentiation suggestions.

## Data Sources
- OpenStreetMap (POI, roads, land use) — public map data, coverage varies by region.
- OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine) — real road routing via public demo server.
- Nominatim — place search and geocoding.
- Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) — official population and density statistics for supported regions.
- LOCIVA internal database — registered businesses and internal POIs.
- Community reports — citizen-submitted infrastructure reports with photos and verification.

## Limitations
- Scores are decision-support indices, not revenue guarantees.
- No real-time traffic data.
- OSM coverage varies by region and is not complete.
- BPS data available only for supported administrative regions (Malang, Bandung, Jakarta, and surrounding regencies).
- AI suggestions are enhancement layer, not the score producer.
- Routes are private by default; sharing is explicit opt-in. No real-time tracking.
